title: Psychedelic 70s Studio Scene
description: A woman with short dark hair kneels on a black and white striped rug in a retro wood-paneled room. She wears a vibrant blue cut-out top, denim shorts, and blue thigh-high boots while holding a small camera on a gimbal, surrounded by swirling green graphic overlays.
prompt: A woman with short black hair kneeling on a black and white striped rug inside a 1970s wood-paneled room featuring bold black and white op art wallpaper and windows. She wears a bright blue cut-out crop top, denim shorts, and matching blue thigh-high platform boots, holding a small camera on a gimbal. Green swirling graphic elements float throughout the scene, retro furniture and decor visible in background, surreal and stylized color photography
